report:
Initial stage: The 19 focal records supported repeated favorable packaging reception within one Experiment-owned TikTok thread: appearance, general approval and refillability enthusiasm. P00’s combined chic/environmentally friendly praise drew 296 displayed likes; environmental claims remained contested by P02 and qualified by the same actor’s elaboration in P03. Recyclability and environmental benefit were unverified. P06 alone reported an unspecified product arriving leaked with a loose top, requiring cleaning and raising an oxygen-exposure concern. P07 offered replacement and brand reassurance; dispatch or resolution was not established. Initial counts were arrival_leak=1, explicit_loose_top=1, bare_arrival_agreement=0, replacement_offered=1, replacement_sent=0, retailer_leak=0 and repurchase_intended=0. This stage is assessed from the supplied prior findings; earlier exact records were not re-retrieved.

Updated stage: Arrival leakage now has recurrence across seven distinct visible TikTok accounts: P06 and P08–P13. P06 and P13 explicitly describe loose/improperly screwed tops; P08 contextually reports the same arrival problem and adds a free replacement sent by Sephora. P09–P12 are four bare agreements in P06’s branch. These agreements support contextual recurrence of the arrival complaint but add no independently specified mechanism, severity or remedy. P06 and P13 provide the detailed recurrence for improperly secured tops accompanying leakage. All remain concentrated in one brand-owned thread; distinct account identities do not verify distinct humans. The complaint SKU/version remains unknown, and agreement cannot silently inherit every detail of P06’s experience.

R01 adds a different condition and known product: retailer-review actor 215817888 reports Softwear–Void’s lid repeatedly unscrewing, including leakage in a pocket at work onto underwear, shirt and jeans, product loss and inability to return recovered product to the package. This supplies cross-role corroboration of the broader reported problem of closures coming loose with leakage across TikTok customer comments and a retailer review, subject to unresolved cross-venue identity overlap. It does not corroborate arrival leakage, identify the TikTok product as Softwear, or establish one shared defect mechanism. Formula/package version is unknown. No opposing leakage experience appears in this bounded set; failure reports have conflict posture none_observed. Overall reception remains mixed: packaging praise coexists with complaints, and environmental reception is contested.

Consequences: P07’s brand replacement offer remains an offer; its reassurance about brief oxygen exposure is not independent product-safety verification. P08 explicitly reports Sephora sent a free replacement, with delivery and resolution unknown. R01 explicitly intends to repurchase despite annoyance about losing an expensive favorite, loves the product, and has would_recommend=true metadata alongside a 3-star rating. Complaint and loyalty therefore coexist within one account. R01 proposes a click-lock or doe-foot alternative; neither is an implemented remedy. Repurchase is future intent, not completed action. P17’s all-Experiment routine and Continuum in the mail show loyalty/pending shipment without packaging attribution. P20’s buying declaration, P32’s conditional saving interest and P38’s trial anticipation do not verify checkout. P04/P27 request refill bundles; P27 names Continuum and Super Saturated without establishing joint use or repurchase. P42 reports receipt and newly discovered refillability, not a refill purchase. P15 proposes empty-container reuse for Lexapro; completion and suitability are unknown. P29’s refill/sticker question remains unresolved. No explicit packaging-caused acquisition, abandonment or return is supplied.

Engagement and limits: Initial displayed likes remain P00 296, P01 39, P02 0, P03 2, P04 0, P06 12, P07 12, P15 150, P17 1, P20 7, P21 1, P26 1, P27 1, P29 2, P32 3, P38 1, P39 1, P40 1 and P42 1. Additions show P08 5, P09 4, P10 4, P11 2, P12 0 and P13 0. P00 and P15 have substantial visible resonance for their respective combined praise and proposed reuse; other values lack sufficient exposure context for firm material-resonance judgments. Likes establish neither verified experience, independence, prevalence nor buying effects. R01 engagement and capture time are unavailable; its 3-star rating and recommendation are author testimony, while product-wide rating aggregates are not engagement on this review or corroboration of its complaint.

All TikTok records share https://www.tiktok.com/@experimentwrld/video/7639858768146222366 and capture time 2026-09-09T11:56:25.935Z; displayed month-day dates lack years. Native comment IDs are unavailable. P00/P03 share an actor, and P01/P07 share the brand actor. R01 is identified by junip:13200181, published 2026-05-10T02:01:45.837Z. No context-only accounts were supplied. The 26 focal records do not constitute all 47 displayed bodies or 72 advertised comments; only the arrival-leak and metal-packaging branches were expanded. Counts below are updated qualifying focal source-key counts, not origin or event counts. No prevalence, verified causal mechanism, damage from oxygen exposure or population-level buying effect is established.
